correctness.rationale: Each part visit with j unseen has optimal discovery probability q_{m,j}=ε+(1−ε)j/m; monotone coupling keeps greedy discovery counts ahead of any competing history-dependent policy, proving stochastic rather than expectation-only dominance. Strict alternation gives independent geometric completion stage sums and exact max representation with initial-vertex clock offset. For fixed ε>0 third moments are uniformly bounded, Riemann-sum means mIε and variances mVε and Lyapunov CLT yield independent shifted normals; max continuous mapping, UI, and Chebyshev complete last-part and expected-time assertions. Independently implemented exact rational dynamic programming over choices corroborated policy and distribution on small (a,b,ε,t) cases.
residual_risks: The ε-fixed-positive CLT does not extend to ε=0 or n-dependent ε without new analysis; small-state dynamic programming does not prove all-horizon dominance.
